concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Server-Sent Events (SSE) to proxy burst.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A local SSE demo streams immediately, but production batches updates. What do you inspect?

production-prompt.rationale: Constraint reviewed: The app logs a flush every second, yet the browser receives thirty events together through the reverse proxy. What will you do?

direct-answer.rationale: Action reviewed: Measure emission and arrival times at each hop, inspect content type and buffering/compression behavior, and apply supported route-specific streaming…

decision-costs.rationale: Cost/alternative reviewed: Disabling buffering changes resource/efficiency trade-offs; periodic status polling may be simpler for coarse progress.

follow-up.rationale: Changed-constraint trap reviewed: A framework flush only empties one buffer and does not prove browser receipt.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to sse, proxy; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Server-Sent Events (SSE) to missing history.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: Last-Event-ID is supplied, but the server no longer has that history. What is the response?

production-prompt.rationale: Constraint reviewed: A tab resumes after two days while event retention is one hour. Financial task completion must not be silently missed. How will you recover?

direct-answer.rationale: Action reviewed: Detect an expired/unknown cursor and trigger a documented snapshot/status resynchronization. Authorize that state request, establish a new continuation…

decision-costs.rationale: Cost/alternative reviewed: Snapshots cost read/catch-up work; retaining more history costs storage and operational capacity.

follow-up.rationale: Changed-constraint trap reviewed: If every historical event is legally required, a durable export/audit contract is separate from this UI stream.

scenarios.theme: A report finishes while the browser is disconnected. How does the user learn that?
scenarios.assumptions: The worker deletes its job record after emitting a completion event. A disconnected user sees “running” forever. What will you change?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A report finishes while the browser is disconnected. How does the user learn that?

production-prompt.rationale: Constraint reviewed: The worker deletes its job record after emitting a completion event. A disconnected user sees “running” forever. What will you change?

direct-answer.rationale: Action reviewed: Persist a terminal job outcome and result reference with an appropriate retention policy. On reconnect or page startup, read status or replay retained…

decision-costs.rationale: Cost/alternative reviewed: Retained terminal state costs storage and expiry design; a durable notification inbox is another approach for longer-lived obligations.

follow-up.rationale: Changed-constraint trap reviewed: Define what happens after result expiry instead of returning a misleading running state.

direct-answer.rationale: Action reviewed: Consolidate compatible subscriptions into a bounded per-page stream, inspect actual HTTP version and client/proxy concurrency limits, and close unused…

scenarios.theme: A slow client accumulates thousands of progress events. Must every percentage be replayed?
scenarios.assumptions: The UI needs current progress and a reliable terminal result, not every intermediate percentage. Slow clients consume too much memory. What will you choose?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Server-Sent Events (SSE) to progress storm.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A slow client accumulates thousands of progress events. Must every percentage be replayed?

production-prompt.rationale: Constraint reviewed: The UI needs current progress and a reliable terminal result, not every intermediate percentage. Slow clients consume too much memory. What will you…

direct-answer.rationale: Action reviewed: Coalesce replaceable progress to the newest state, bound outbound queues and preserve authoritative terminal outcome/status. Disconnect/resync clients…

decision-costs.rationale: Cost/alternative reviewed: Coalescing loses intermediate observations; a full event log is preferable for auditing or per-event obligations.

follow-up.rationale: Changed-constraint trap reviewed: Receiving an event is still distinct from the client completing its associated work.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to sse, proxy; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.
